title: District Commission must not grant adjournment without sufficient cause
description: Who: District Commission. What: must not grant adjournment without sufficient cause. Conditions: sufficient cause is shown. Limitations: within a period of three months from the date of receipt of notice by opposite party where the complaint does not require analysis or testing of commodities; within five months if it requires analysis or testing of commodities
